Container.Name: deedup
Container.Overview: deedup: dedupe your hoard, safely. Finds duplicate files across your Unraid disks by content, whatever their names. Milestone 1 is report-only: /mnt is mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Disks and shares (read-only)
Config.Description: Host /mnt, mounted READ-ONLY. deedup reads /mnt/diskN and pools directly.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Index database. Put it on the cache pool.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on basic auth for the web UI (user name: deedup).
